title: Terminal
description: A shell in this sandbox. It connects only when you attach, and nothing you type or see is saved.
unavailable: The terminal can be attached only while the sandbox is Ready.

notice.client: You disconnected. The terminal session has ended.
notice.detached: The terminal connection dropped, and the session ended.
notice.replaced: The terminal was attached somewhere else (another tab or device), so this one was disconnected.
notice.backpressure: The terminal could not keep up with the data, so it was disconnected. Attach again to start a new session.
notice.revoked: Your sign-in no longer allows this terminal. Sign in again, then attach.
notice.superseded: The sandbox was restarted, so this terminal ended.
notice.protocolViolation: The terminal stream broke, so it was disconnected.
notice.hostDisconnected: The sandbox's host disconnected, so the terminal ended.
notice.expired: The sandbox's lifetime ran out, so the terminal ended.
notice.openTimedOut: The host did not open the terminal in time. Try again.
notice.sandboxStopped: The sandbox stopped, so the terminal ended.
notice.sandboxDestroyed: The sandbox was deleted, so the terminal ended.
notice.lifecycleUnconfirmed: The server could not confirm that the sandbox is still running, so it closed the terminal.
notice.shutdown: The server restarted, so the terminal ended.
notice.hostShutdown: The sandbox's node daemon was stopped, so the terminal ended. Attach again once the host is back.
notice.hostRevoked: The sandbox's host is no longer authorized (its credential was revoked or expired, or the host was removed), so the terminal ended.
notice.noTerminalIdentity: This sandbox cannot open a terminal. Sandboxes created before terminals were available have no recorded guest user: reconnect the sandbox, or stop and start it, then attach again. If that does not help, the host's daemon may need an update.
notice.hostCapacity: The host has too many terminals open right now. Try again in a moment.
notice.connectionLost: The connection to the terminal was lost, and the session ended.
notice.couldNotConnect: Could not connect to the terminal. Check your connection, then try again.
notice.signedOut: Your session has expired. Sign in again to use the terminal.
notice.forbidden: Your account cannot open a terminal right now. Check your two-factor authentication settings.
notice.notReady: The sandbox is not ready for a terminal. Wait until it is Ready, then attach.
notice.rateLimited: Too many terminal sessions were opened. Wait a minute, then try again.
notice.unavailable: Terminals are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
notice.createFailed: Could not start a terminal session. Try again.
notice.pageLeft: The terminal was closed when you left or suspended this page. Attach again to start a new session.
notice.insecure: The terminal needs a secure (HTTPS) connection to the server.
notice.loadFailed: The terminal could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.
notice.hostExpired: Host shell expired after its input-idle or lifetime limit. Attach manually to start a new shell.
notice.poolAccessRemoved: Pool access was removed and no usable path remains for this sandbox. The terminal ended.
notice.hostTerminalsDisabled: Host terminals were disabled locally on this host. Enable them on the host before attaching again.
notice.resumeFailed: Could not reattach to the terminal. Attach again to start a new session.

warning.inputThrottled: Input is arriving faster than the sandbox accepts it, so some of it was dropped.
warning.inputTooLarge: That input was too large and was not sent.
warning.notReadyYet: The terminal is not ready for input yet.
warning.outputLost: Some terminal output was lost while reconnecting.

clipboard.copyEmpty: Select text in the terminal first.
clipboard.pasteTooLarge: That paste is too large to send safely, so nothing was pasted.
clipboard.unavailable: The browser did not allow clipboard access.
clipboard.typed: Typed into the terminal. Press Enter to run it.

host.title: Host terminal
host.warning: This shell runs with the daemon user’s local powers. It can reach guests through local administrator privileges. Detach ends this PTY; attaching again starts a new shell.
host.disabled: Host terminals are disabled locally. Enable with wssp host config set-host-terminal on on the host.
host.offline: No current host policy is available. Connect the host before attaching or raising TOTP.
host.required: Fresh TOTP is required for each attach. Only local access can lower this requirement.
host.optional: TOTP is optional on this host. Press Attach explicitly to open a shell.
host.unconfirmed: Waiting for the host to persist and acknowledge the policy…
host.confirmed: Host confirmed the persisted TOTP requirement.
host.raiseFailed: Policy change is unconfirmed. Offline requests are not saved. Refresh and retry explicitly on the connected host.
host.fresh: Enter a new unused six-digit authenticator code. Codes clear after every attempt; a refused connection needs a manual retry with a new code.
host.enroll: Set up an authenticator in Security settings
host.enrollment: Enroll and verify TOTP in Security settings before attaching.
host.cooldown: First or changed factor observed. Wait ten minutes before retrying with a new code.
host.locked: Proof attempts are locked. Wait at least fifteen minutes and retry with a new code after the lock expires.
host.refused: Host terminal refused. Check your session, local policy and fresh code before a manual retry.
host.unavailable: Connect the host and enable local host terminals before attaching.
